description: This header file declares internal functions related to device configuration and XML parsing for a camera system, including functions for handling audio channels, video inputs, network interfaces, and motion detection settings within the ohcm codebase.

methods.name: parseOhcmDeviceXmlNode
methods.description: Parses an XML node to extract device information into ohcmDeviceInfo object.

methods.name: parseOhcmAudioListXmlNode
methods.description: Parses XML list of audio channels into a linked list of ohcmAudioChannel objects.

methods.name: parseOhcmAudioXmlNode
methods.description: Parses an XML node for a single audio channel into an ohcmAudioChannel object.

methods.name: appendOhcmAudioChannelListXml
methods.description: Generates XML for a list of ohcmAudioChannel objects and appends it to the root node.

methods.name: printOhcmAudioChannel
methods.description: Prints debug information about an ohcmAudioChannel object.

methods.name: parseOhcmVideoInputChannelListXmlNode
methods.description: Parses an XML list of video inputs into a linked list of ohcmVideoInput objects.

methods.name: parseOhcmVideoInputChannelXmlNode
methods.description: Parses an XML node for a single video input into an ohcmVideoInput object.

methods.name: appendOhcmVideoInputChannelListXml
methods.description: Generates XML for a list of ohcmVideoInput objects.

methods.name: parseOhcmStreamChannelListXmlNode
methods.description: Parses an XML list of stream objects.

methods.name: appendOhcmStreamChannelListXml
methods.description: Generates XML for a list of stream channel objects.

methods.name: parseOhcmMotionDetectionListXmlNode
methods.description: Parses an XML list of motion detection settings.

methods.name: parseOhcmWirelessStatusXmlNode
methods.description: Parses an XML node for wireless status information of a network interface.

methods.name: parseOhcmNetworkXmlNode
methods.description: Parses XML data for a single network interface.

methods.name: parseOhcmNetworkListXmlNode
methods.description: Parses an XML list of network interfaces.

methods.name: appendOhcmNetworkInterfaceListXml
methods.description: Generates XML for a list of network interface objects.
